sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Leaper is an endless runner game where you control a character that must leap over obstacles to climb higher and higher. The game's controls are easy to use, with options for mouse, keyboard, or touch controls. Your character will automatically move forward, and you'll need to time your leaps perfectly to avoid obstacles and collect power-ups. The game gets progressively harder as you climb higher, with more obstacles and challenges appearing on the screen.

One of the key features of Leaper is its ability to adapt to your playing style. If you're a beginner, the game will start off relatively easy, with fewer obstacles and a slower pace. As you get more comfortable, the game will gradually increase in difficulty, challenging you to improve your skills and timing. This makes Leaper perfect for players of all levels, from casual gamers to seasoned pros.

The game also features a variety of power-ups that you can collect to aid you in your climb. These power-ups can give you a temporary boost in speed, make your character invincible, or even grant you a second chance if you fail to leap over an obstacle. Collecting power-ups is a great way to stay ahead of the game and reach new heights.
